title: Avocado & Egg Toast
description: A protein-rich breakfast perfect for breaking your fast with healthy fats and sustained energy.
steps: Toast the bread until golden and crispy.
While bread toasts, heat olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Crack eggs into the pan and cook to your preference (sunny-side up or over-easy).
Halve the avocado, remove the pit, and scoop flesh onto the toast.
Mash the avocado lightly with a fork, leaving some chunks for texture.
Place the cooked eggs on top of the avocado toast.
Season with salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes if desired.

title: Greek Yogurt Power Bowl
description: A nutrient-dense bowl packed with protein and antioxidants — ideal for your first meal after fasting.
ingredients: 200g Greek yogurt (full fat or low fat)
steps: Spoon Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Arrange mixed berries on top of the yogurt.
Sprinkle granola and chia seeds over the berries.
Drizzle with honey or maple syrup.
Add a dollop of almond butter on top.
Serve immediately for best texture.

title: Spinach & Feta Omelette
description: A high-protein omelette loaded with greens and tangy feta cheese for a satisfying fast-breaking meal.
steps: Whisk eggs in a bowl with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Heat butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add spinach and cook for 1 minute until slightly wilted.
Pour whisked eggs over the spinach, tilting pan to spread evenly.
Cook for 2-3 minutes until edges set.
Add feta cheese and cherry tomatoes to one half.
Fold the omelette in half and cook for another minute.
Slide onto a plate and serve.

title: Grilled Chicken Salad
description: A hearty salad with grilled chicken, mixed greens, and a light vinaigrette — balanced nutrition in every bite.
steps: Season chicken breast with salt and pepper.
Grill or pan-fry chicken for 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through.
Let chicken rest for 5 minutes, then slice.
Arrange mixed greens on a plate.
Top with cucumber, cherry tomatoes, red onion, and avocado.
Place sliced chicken on top of the salad.
Whisk olive oil and balsamic vinegar together for dressing.
Drizzle dressing over the salad and serve.

title: Quinoa Buddha Bowl
description: A colourful plant-based bowl with quinoa, roasted vegetables, and tahini dressing for sustained energy.
steps: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F).
Cook quinoa: bring water to a boil, add quinoa, reduce heat, cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
Toss sweet potato and broccoli with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Spread vegetables on a baking tray and roast for 20 minutes.
Mix tahini with lemon juice and 1 tbsp water to make dressing.
Assemble bowl: quinoa base, roasted vegetables, and chickpeas.
Drizzle tahini dressing over the top.
Season with additional salt and pepper if needed.

title: Tuna & White Bean Salad
description: A quick, no-cook lunch packed with protein and fibre — perfect for busy days during your eating window.
ingredients: 1 can (170g) tuna in olive oil, drained
1 can (400g) white beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Drain and flake the tuna into a large bowl.
Add drained white beans to the bowl.
Add diced red onion and rocket.
Whisk together olive oil and red wine vinegar.
Pour dressing over the salad and toss gently.
Season with salt and pepper.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve.

title: Baked Salmon with Roasted Vegetables
description: Omega-3 rich salmon paired with colourful roasted vegetables for a nutritious dinner within your eating window.
steps: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F).
Place salmon on a lined baking tray. Season with salt, pepper, garlic, and lemon juice.
Toss broccoli, carrot, and bell pepper with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Arrange vegetables around the salmon on the tray.
Bake for 15-18 minutes until salmon is cooked through and flakes easily.
Garnish with fresh dill if desired.
Serve immediately.

title: Turkey Stir-Fry with Brown Rice
description: A lean protein stir-fry with crisp vegetables served over brown rice — filling and nutritious.
ingredients: 1 cup mixed stir-fry vegetables (bell peppers, snap peas, mushrooms)
1 tsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water
steps: Cook brown rice according to package directions (or use pre-cooked).
Heat sesame oil in a wok or large pan over high heat.
Add turkey slices and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until browned.
Add garlic and ginger, cook for 30 seconds.
Add mixed vegetables and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Pour in soy sauce and cornstarch mixture.
Stir until sauce thickens and coats everything evenly.
Serve over brown rice.

title: Lentil & Vegetable Curry
description: A warming plant-based curry rich in protein and fibre — comforting and perfect for your last meal of the day.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Sauté onion for 3-4 minutes until softened.
Add garlic, curry powder, and turmeric. Cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add lentils, coconut milk, and vegetable broth.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes until lentils are tender.
Stir in spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted.
Season with salt to taste.
Serve over rice or with naan bread.

title: Almond Energy Bites
description: No-bake energy bites made with almonds, oats, and honey — a quick snack to fuel your eating window.
steps: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well.
Refrigerate the mixture for 15-20 minutes until firm enough to handle.
Roll into small balls (about 1 tablespoon each).
Place on a lined tray or plate.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.
Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to one week.

title: Hummus & Veggie Sticks
description: Classic hummus paired with fresh vegetable sticks — a satisfying, nutrient-rich snack.
ingredients: Carrot sticks, cucumber sticks, bell pepper strips for dipping
steps: Add chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and olive oil to a food processor.
Blend until smooth, scraping down sides as needed.
Add 1-2 tablespoons of water if too thick.
Season with salt and blend again briefly.
Transfer to a serving bowl and drizzle with extra olive oil.
Serve with fresh vegetable sticks for dipping.

title: Mixed Nuts & Dark Chocolate
description: A simple combination of mixed nuts and dark chocolate — healthy fats and antioxidants in a handful.
ingredients: 20g dark chocolate (70%+ cocoa), broken into pieces
steps: Measure out each type of nut.
Break dark chocolate into small pieces.
Combine nuts, chocolate, and dried cranberries in a small bowl or container.
Mix gently.
Portion into small containers for grab-and-go snacking.
Store in a cool, dry place.

title: Green Power Smoothie
description: A nutrient-packed green smoothie to gently break your fast with vitamins and minerals.
steps: Add almond milk to the blender first.
Add spinach and blend briefly until broken down.
Add frozen banana, mango chunks, chia seeds, and ginger.
Blend on high for 60-90 seconds until smooth.
Pour into a glass.
Serve immediately for best taste and nutrition.

title: Berry Protein Smoothie
description: A protein-rich berry smoothie perfect for post-fast recovery and muscle support.
ingredients: 1/2 cup water or milk of choice
steps: Add liquid to the blender first.
Add Greek yogurt and protein powder.
Add mixed berries and flaxseed.
Add ice cubes if desired for a thicker consistency.
Blend on high for 45-60 seconds until smooth and creamy.
Pour into a glass and enjoy immediately.

title: Tropical Coconut Smoothie
description: A refreshing tropical smoothie with coconut and pineapple — hydrating and energising for your eating window.
steps: Add coconut milk and coconut water to the blender.
Add frozen pineapple and banana.
Add hemp seeds.
Blend on high for 60 seconds until smooth.
Pour into a glass.
Top with shredded coconut and serve.
